claims.claim: Insurance and fiscal data confirm the loss is real but not yet fully aggregated: by 13 July 2026, insurers in 20 provinces had received nearly 380,000 claims with estimated losses of RMB 6.38 billion and RMB 2.89 billion already paid.

The private document's own investment preference is explicit: prioritize companies with existing government orders and O&M revenue in water conservancy digitalization, monitoring and early warning, and drainage equipment, rather than short-term materials.
